annotations.title: Create a Google Demand Gen video campaign (YouTube Shorts, in-feed, in-stream)

description: Build a Google DEMAND GEN campaign — video ads on YouTube Shorts, in-feed and in-stream (plus Discover, Gmail, Display, Maps if you pick them) — as ONE atomic, PAUSED build: budget, campaign, ad group with channel controls, locations/languages, optional audiences, and a video ad. ad needs videoAssets (from upload_google_ads_video) or youtubeVideoIds, a square logo (logoImage or logoAssets), finalUrl, businessName ≤25, 1–5 headlines, longHeadlines, descriptions. Google sets a minimum daily budget (it names it if you go under). Read back; turn it on with set_google_ads_status(confirm:true) only after the user approves.

ad.description: video ad: {videoAssets or youtubeVideoIds, logo, finalUrl, businessName, headlines, longHeadlines, descriptions}

businessName.description: business name shown with the ad, 25 characters maximum

finalUrl.description: landing page the ad opens, full http or https URL

logoAssets.description: square (1:1) logo asset resource names from upload_google_ads_asset; alternative to logoImage

logoImage.description: square (1:1) logo image URL or Hermoso asset; used when logoAssets is empty

name.description: name of the ad inside Google Ads (optional)

videoAssets.description: video asset resource names from upload_google_ads_video; one of this or youtubeVideoIds is required

youtubeVideoIds.description: YouTube video ids of existing videos; alternative to videoAssets

bidding.description: bidding object {strategy, targetCpaUsd, targetRoas, maxCpcUsd}; strategy defaults to MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS

maxCpcUsd.description: maximum cost per click in the ACCOUNT’s currency

strategy.description: bidding strategy; defaults to MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS when omitted

targetCpaUsd.description: target cost per conversion in the ACCOUNT’s currency, for TARGET_CPA

targetRoas.description: target return as a ratio, e.g. 4 = $4 of revenue per $1 spent, for TARGET_ROAS

budgetResourceName.description: existing campaign budget resource name to reuse instead of creating a new budget

channels.description: omit for all of Google's channels

containsEuPoliticalAds.description: true only for genuine EU political advertising

countryCode.description: 2-letter country code that disambiguates a place name, e.g. CA for Toronto

customerId.description: Google Ads account id, 10 digits (dashes ok); omit for the brand's default account

dailyBudgetUsd.description: daily budget in the ACCOUNT’s currency (historical name, not necessarily USD), 1 to 100000; required unless budgetResourceName is given

dryRun.description: true = validate with Google and create nothing

excludedLocations.description: place names to exclude, resolved by Google

finalUrlSuffix.description: UTM suffix appended to clicks; omit for Hermoso's default, empty string for none

languages.description: ISO language codes to target, e.g. ["en"]

locations.description: place names to target, resolved by Google, e.g. United States

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id, when the account is managed through one

trackingUrlTemplate.description: click-tracking redirect template, e.g. {lpurl}?src=x; only if you use a tracker

urlCustomParameters.description: up to 8 custom URL parameters, used in URLs as {_key}

name: create_google_ads_demand_gen_campaign
